test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A reduction of 20% in the price of wheat enables a housewife to obtain 4 kgs more for Rs. 1200, what is the reduced price per kg (in Rs.)?
solution:
**Given:**

For reduction of 20% in the price of wheat she can get 4 kg more in Rs. 1200

**Calculation:**

Let the price per kg of wheat was Rs. 100x and

So, after 20% reduction new price = 100x - 100x × 20%

⇒ Rs. 80x

According to question,

New quantity rice – old quantity rice = 4 kg

⇒ 1200/80x – 1200/100x = 4 

⇒ 15/x - 12/x = 4

⇒ (15 - 12)/x = 4

⇒ 3/x = 4

⇒ x = 3/4 

S0, new price = Rs. (80 × 3/4)

⇒ Rs. 60 per kg

**∴ The reduced price per kg (in Rs.) is 60.**
